inboundRulesAbout: Every enabled inbound Allow firewall rule the box keeps, by its Name or DisplayName (#3807). scripts/vps/Set-InboundRules.ps1 turns off every other one, and Check-ProdParity.ps1 marks one outside this list for review. required: the rule must be there and on, or Set-InboundRules refuses to turn anything off. Not on the list, so off: WinRM, the old SkyMP copies of the game rules, Teredo, IP-HTTPS and IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnels, Delivery Optimization, DIAL, Cast to Device, AllJoyn, mDNS, Media Foundation and the Store apps' rules.
